# Medical AI screening queue

Generated automatically; review venue, scope, abstract, and link before adding to README. Scores are rule-based ranking signals, not relevance probabilities. `candidate` means the title matched a specific rule; `review` includes broad or abstract-only matches.

See [coverage](coverage.md) for failures, catalog fallbacks, abstract coverage, and unmatched README entries. Possible duplicate matches are retained for human review. Explicit exclusions in [the curation ledger](../data/curation.json) are omitted; their full records remain in the index.
